name: Budget-Flow
description: Full-stack personal finance and budget tracking web application built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase for expense management, budget planning, financial analytics, and real-time database tracking.

paragraphs: Budget Flow is a modern, full-stack personal finance and budget tracking web application designed to simplify wealth management, expense tracking, and financial planning. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase, Budget Flow empowers users to monitor spending, set dynamic budgets, analyze income vs. expense analytics, and maintain financial clarity through a clean, intuitive interface.
The project demonstrates how modern web technologies and real-time database architectures can deliver a seamless, privacy-focused financial management platform.
features: 📊 Interactive Dashboard: High-level summary of total balance, income, expenses, and savings rate.
💸 Transaction Tracking: Easily log, categorize, and filter income and expense records.
🎯 Budget Planning & Allocation: Set category-based spending targets and receive real-time budget limit alerts.
📈 Financial Analytics & Charts: Visual breakdowns of spending patterns, monthly comparisons, and category distributions.
🗄️ Supabase Integration: Full database management with real-time sync and SQL migration support.
